user.title: Connect to Qixu voice service
user.description: Home Assistant dials out to this endpoint and offers the entities exposed to voice assistants. The connection is tested before saving.

data_description.endpoint: Issued by the Qixu console, e.g. wss://voice.example.com/mcp
data_description.token: Sent with the connection so the Qixu service can identify this Home Assistant
data_description.home_id: If set, Qixu checks that it matches the home the token belongs to. Leave empty if unsure
data_description.llm_hass_api: Usually Assist. You can also select other MCP servers configured in Home Assistant to offer them to Qixu
data_description.confirm_keywords: Comma separated. Matching tool calls return a confirm ID and run only after confirmation

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter Qixu token
reauth_confirm.description: Qixu rejected the current token (endpoint {endpoint}). It may have been revoked or mistyped. Create a new token in the Qixu console and enter it here.

error.invalid_endpoint: Endpoint must start with ws:// or wss://
error.llm_api_required: Select at least one control API
error.invalid_auth: Qixu rejected the token, or the site ID does not belong to the token's home
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the endpoint. Check the address and network

abort.already_configured: This endpoint and site ID are already configured
